hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Notice how alternate elimination from left and right reduces the remaining candidate count by half each step.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Track the index of the first remaining element along with the current stride distance between survivors.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Update the head index whenever the elimination starts from the left or when the surviving length is odd.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def finalElement(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    n = len(nums)
    if n == 1:
        return nums[0]
    idx = 0
    step = 1
    remaining = n
    left = True
    while remaining > 1:
        if left or remaining % 2 == 1:
            idx += step
        remaining //= 2
        step *= 2
        left = not left
    return nums[idx]
```

complexity.notes: The number of remaining elements is divided by 2 each round, completing in O(log n) steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A brute force approach would exceed time limits by redundantly reprocessing states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Balances linear traversal with auxiliary tracking structures.
